sec1_card1_desc: Small businesses where everyone does a bit of everything and information gets scattered.
sec1_card2_desc: Critical processes managed in separate spreadsheets with no audit trail.
sec1_card3_desc: Time lost locating the latest version of a proposal or signed contract.
sec1_card4_desc: Need to monitor balances, pending items, and budgets without accounting bloat.
sec1_card5_desc: Preventing client history from depending solely on a single employee's memory.
sec1_card6_desc: Guaranteeing financial data and access logs are sealed with SHA-256 proofs.
sec2_card1_q: "Will my team know how to use it?"
sec2_card1_a: The interface was designed for people used to paper or Excel. No technical jargon or hidden menus.
sec2_card2_q: "How long does it take to deploy?"
sec2_card2_a: Implementation is modular. In just a few days the first module is live without disrupting daily work.
sec2_card3_q: "Do I have to change my workflow?"
sec2_card3_a: No. HELDERLABS ERP adapts to your existing habits, organizing what you already do rather than imposing rules.
sec2_card4_a: Yes. Every company has strict multi-tenant isolation and all actions are audit-chained with cryptographic signatures.
sec3_step1_desc: We identify the repetitive tasks consuming the most time from your team.
sec3_step2_desc: We activate only the required modules using your real test data.
sec3_step3_desc: Simple training for your team and direct hands-on support during launch.
sec4_subtitle: We only showcase modules in active or beta state with real production capabilities.
sec5_p1_lead: I am Hélder Guiomar, software engineer and consultant. I work directly with small businesses to solve real organization challenges.
sec5_p2: I do not sell off-the-shelf generic software or bloated projects taking years to deploy. My commitment is to deliver simple, solid, and auditable tools working on day one.
sec5_quote: "Direct engagement, no middlemen, no vanity metric promises."
sec6_p1: Fill out the form with a summary of your situation. I reply directly within 24 hours to schedule a short call.
sec6_check1: Direct response from the lead software engineer
